notes.title: Summer 2021 Update!
notes.content:
Bouncy Bombs are now beach balls!

Gravel blocks were added!

notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.content:
The first new bomb has been added! Bouncy Bombs! Bouncy Bombs look like jack o lanterns and will explode after bouncing!

Some minor bug fixes involving the upgrades menu have been implemented as well.
